detail.longDescription: 🤖 CVE-2026-105445 (critical): Docker Hub reassigned a user's PAT to a new org owner without rotating the secret, so the attacker's token authenticated as the target — pull, push and delete of images. Rated critical as a supply chain risk. Fixed Sept 30, no exploitation found. 🔗 https://www. bleepingcomputer.com/news/secu rity/docker-hub-flaw-let-attackers-impersonate-users-tamper-with-images/ # CVE # SupplyChain # CyberSec # Docker
